transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: I mix approaches: break words into syllables and roots first, then map sounds to likely spellings (phonetics) — that helps with unfamiliar words. For mnemonics I build tiny images or stories for tricky bits (e.g., accommodate = two cots and two mattresses → two c’s, two m’s), and I watch for common patterns like silent letters and doubled consonants. For pressure practice I do short timed drills (30–60s rounds, 8–12 words), warm up with 5 minutes of reading aloud and quick suffix/prefix drills, and use box breathing (inhale 4, hold 4, exhale 4) or one slow exhale before I spell to reset. Want to try a 5-minute timed round now? I’ll quiz you, give gentle hints, and we’ll build up from there.

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content: Quick rule of thumb: if you hear one long “A” sound (the “ay” in rain) expect ai/ay; if you hear two vowel sounds or a glide (like “ee‑uh” or a “y” glide — think di‑a / di‑ə or dy‑uh) expect ia. Also watch roots: Greek/Latin prefixes like dia‑ usually split into two syllables (diabetes, diagonal), whereas ai/ay tend to represent a single vowel sound. Want me to throw you a few paired examples to practice this?

transcript.speaker: Naomi Fletcher
transcript.content:
Quick rule: if you hear one clear long “A” (the “ay” in rain) expect ai/ay; if you hear two sounds or an “ee‑uh”/“y” glide, expect ia (or a split syllable). A few paired examples: 

1) ai: rain — single A sound (/reɪn/). Mnemonic: “rain = A in the sky (ai).”
   ia: media — glide/ee‑uh (/ˈmiːdiə/). Mnemonic: “media = me‑uh (me + uh).”

2) ai: paint — single A sound (/peɪnt/). Mnemonic: “paint the A.”
   ia: diagonal (dia‑) — two sounds/diphthong (ˈdaɪə‑) as in dye‑uh. Mnemonic: “dia = die + ah.”

3) ai: sail — single A sound (/seɪl/). Mnemonic: “sail = A in the sail.”
   ia: trivia — glide/ee‑uh (/ˈtrɪviə/). Mnemonic: “trivia = tri‑vee‑uh (tiny facts).”

Want me to throw 6 mixed words at you (labeling whether I expect ai or ia and why) so you can practice spotting the pattern under time pressure?

2) Media — ia (glide /iə/). Mnemonic: “me‑uh = me + uh.”
